description: This file defines the 'Comments.Create' feature in an ASP.NET Core application, including request models, validation, and handler logic to create a new comment associated with an article identified by its slug.

classes.name: Create
classes.description: Namespace class encapsulating the comment creation feature, including nested record types, validator, and handler.
